name: r3_hardy_inequality_finite
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k ^ 2
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k ^ 2
informal: Hardy's inequality for finite sums with the sharp constant 4 (p = 2): the sum of squares of the running averages is at most 4 times the sum of squares. Proof idea: with α_k the k-th average, a_k = kα_k - (k-1)α_{k-1}, show α_k^2 - 2α_k a_k ≤ (k-1)α_{k-1}^2 - kα_k^2 (AM-GM on the cross term), telescope to get Σα_k^2 ≤ 2Σα_k a_k, then Cauchy–Schwarz and cancel sqrt(Σα_k^2).
type: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / (↑k + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k ^ 2

  have hpt : ∀ k : ℕ, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
      - 2 * ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) * a k
      ≤ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, a i) ^ 2 / (k : ℝ) - (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) ^ 2 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    clear n
    sorry
  have htel : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2
      ≤ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) * a k := by
    sorry
  have hfin : ∀ T B Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ T → T ≤ 2 * Q → Q ^ 2 ≤ T * B → T ≤ 4 * B := by
    clear hpt htel a n
    sorry
  have hcs := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.range n)
    (fun k => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a i) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) a
  exact hfin _ _ _ (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)) htel hcs
